title: OpenAI 发布新的语音模型，实现更自然的实时对话
content: OpenAI 表示，其新的语音模式可以同时说和听，这是实时翻译的关键能力。
original_title: OpenAI releases new voice models for more natural live conversations
original_content: OpenAI says its new voice mode can speak and listen at the same time, a key ability for live translation.

title: Meta 刚刚推出了一款新的人工智能生成器 Muse Image，用户已经开始拒绝使用他们的照片
content: 新的图像生成模型有许多用例，包括广告和装饰以及基于创作者的机会。
original_title: Meta just launched a new AI generator, Muse Image, and users are already pushing back over use of their photos
original_content: The new image-generating model has numerous use cases, including advertising and decorating, and creator-based opportunities.

title: Show HN：微软发布 Flint，一种用于 AI 代理的可视化语言
original_title: Show HN: Microsoft releases Flint, a visualization language for AI agents

title: SpaceXAI 发布了 Grok 4.5，Elon 将其描述为“Opus 级模型”
content: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的科技公司周三发布了最新版本的 Grok，承诺提供比其他强大人工智能模型更便宜、更高效的替代方案。
original_title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5, which Elon describes as an ‘Opus-class model’
original_content: Elon Musk's tech company released the newest version of Grok on Wednesday, promising a cheaper, more efficient alternative to other powerful AI models.

title: 法国热门初创公司 ZML 发布免费产品，以加快多种人工智能芯片的推理速度
content: ZML 是一家热门的法国人工智能初创公司，得到了图灵奖得主 Yann LeCun 的认可，现在发布了 ZML/LLMD 软件，可以降低运行人工智能的成本。
original_title: Hot French startup ZML releases free product to speed inference across lots of AI chips
original_content: ZML, a hot French AI startup endorsed by Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, has now released ZML/LLMD, software that could make running AI less costly.

title: AI 芯片制造商 SambaNova 在上一轮大型融资 5 个月后以 11B 美元估值筹集 10 亿美元
content: AI 芯片制造商 SambaNova 的估值达到 110 亿美元，而几个月前，有传言称英特尔试图以约 16 亿美元的价格收购该公司。
original_title: AI chip maker SambaNova raises $1B at $11B valuation, 5 months after last mega round
original_content: AI chip maker SambaNova has raised at an $11 billion valuation months after Intel was rumored to be trying to buy it for about $1.6 billion.

title: 英国太空初创公司将长寿实验室送入轨道
content: 该实验室将传回数据来训练人工智能模型，以预测阿尔茨海默病和某些癌症等与年龄相关的疾病背后的蛋白质如何表现。
original_title: British Space Startup Launches Longevity Lab Into Orbit
original_content: The lab will beam back data to train AI models to predict how proteins behind age-related diseases like Alzheimer’s and certain cancers behave.
